model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms evaluated across a base model and several fine-tuned models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," which are ordered alphabetically: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Negative log probability," utilizing a linear scale with values ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, marked by numeric tick labels at intervals of 1. Because the axis values are negative and decrease downwards, the bars extend downwards from the top -22 baseline. Within each horizontal category, data is visually arranged into groups of seven adjacent bars. According to the top legends, the first bar in each group is colored light blue and represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The remaining six bars in each group represent models "Fine-tuned on:" Cardio (lightest beige), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium-light orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (darkest brown). The light blue base model consistently exhibits the longest downward bars in every category, reaching its most negative value at approximately -26.8 in the Cardio group, which is the longest bar overall. By contrast, the fine-tuned models have shorter downward extensions, displaying values closer to zero, with the shortest overall downward bars located in the Infect category at roughly -23.0 to -23.2. Across the groups, the fine-tuned models generate values generally ranging between -23.5 and -26.1 depending on the specialty. Both the horizontal axis categories and the fine-tuned model legend entries are sorted alphabetically, and no individual bars are additionally emphasized with outlines or annotations beyond their standard assigned legend colors.
